topic: A dirty engine air filter is choking your power and your gas mileage

beats.narration: Your car feels sluggish, and you're filling up more than you used to.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on a dashboard tachometer/MPG trip-computer readout, static-mounted camera, dim interior lighting, shallow depth of field, engine bay visible faintly through a windshield reflection.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Acceleration feels weak. Idle's a little rough. Maybe a whiff of gas smell at startup.
beats.visualPrompt: Low-angle shot of an idling engine bay, subtle vibration at idle; quick cut to a dashboard fuel-gauge needle sitting lower than expected.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: One clue: a clogged engine air filter. It can choke off the air your engine needs to breathe.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro/cutaway shot: an engine air filter housing opened, the pleated paper filter element lifted out, visibly dark and clogged with dust/debris, workbench setting, slow push-in.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Less air means a richer fuel mix — less power, worse mileage.
beats.visualPrompt: Side-by-side static composition: a clean white pleated filter next to the dirty one from beat 3, studio-lit, no hands in frame.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: It's a 30-second check. Pull the filter, hold it to the light — if you can't see through it, it's time.
beats.visualPrompt: The dirty filter held up backlit by a work-light on a stand, light visibly failing to pass through the clogged section, shop bay softly blurred behind it.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Worth checking before it costs you more at the pump. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, static hold.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles
